caption: The drawing depicts a singular human-like figure with a golden-brown body and exaggerated features. The figure is standing on one leg while the other leg appears to rest on a metallic peg. It has bare feet and wears a decorative band around the waist and thighs, possibly representing a skirt or loincloth, with additional embellishments at the hips and a necklace made of rounded beads. The figure's chest is accentuated with rounded shapes. The head is adorned with a headdress containing three upright feathers and ribbon-like trails at the back. The face is in profile, showing a pronounced nose, lips, and a large eye. The arms are extended, holding a yellow bow in the left hand and pulling back an arrow with a triangular, double-pronged tip in the right hand, ready to shoot. The entire composition is outlined in dark lines, and the background is plain, off-white, with no additional elements. The overall appearance is that of a stylized archer figure, likely metallic or statue-like in texture, with detailed decoration primarily in shades of gold, brown, and yellow.
title: Weather Vane
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
